The '''Vernet Imperial Army Training Camp''' was a military base established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]], the camp consisted of barracks for the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and the trainees, equipment and vehicle and storage, and a training center. The base was encircled by a [[Force field/Legends|force field]].<ref name="TD" />

When the base was established, the Empire conscripted all able bodied males aged eighteen to twenty-five and began indoctrinating them into the believing in the tenets of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. There would have been various methods of indoctrination being applied to these trainees, through various measures such as drugged food and subliminal messaging, as example, in the case of [[Kristoff Stonelaw]]. Over one hundred trainees were instructed at the camp, overseen by three officers and ten non-commissioned officers. Twenty five support droids and six [[E2-I6]] droids were stationed at the camp.<ref name="TD" />
